narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

`orderTotal` in `[src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39)` was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, so any row with both a nonzero discount and nonzero tax rate was off. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.

No further action needed.
